features.title: [DEMO] Wire LightRAG Core to storages and model clients
features.behavior: Добавляется pinned LightRAG Core dependency. LightRAG настраивается на PostgreSQL-backed internal storage, Qdrant, Neo4j, embedding client и external LLM. Integration test доказывает минимальный insert/query на реальных storage.

features.behavior: LightRAGRuntimeRegistry создаёт runtime по server-generated workspace.storage_key после получения AuthorizedWorkspaceContext. Реализуются lazy initialization и graceful close. Client не может выбрать physical namespace напрямую.

features.title: [DEMO] Implement reusable inline IndexingService
features.behavior: IndexingService читает source, выбирает parser, переводит document в INDEXING, вызывает LightRAG insert и завершает READY/FAILED. Сервис не зависит от FastAPI request objects, чтобы позднее использоваться rag-worker без переписывания core logic.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F022 criteria. Focused tests: 10 passed. Full verification passed Ruff, format, mypy, 213 unit tests and integration suite (7 passed, 11 skipped, 1 deselected). Adversarial cancellation probes confirmed that cancellation after INDEXING makes a cancellation-safe FAILED transition, preserves the original CancelledError despite cleanup failure or repeated cancellation, and leaves no orphan tasks. The service reads through DocumentSourceService, selects parsers through ParserRegistry, obtains runtimes only from AuthorizedWorkspaceContext via LightRAGRuntimeRegistry, and has no FastAPI dependency. git diff --check passed.

features.title: [DEMO] Expose document upload/read API
features.behavior: POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/documents работает в demo_owner mode без JWT: создаёт document metadata, сохраняет source и запускает inline IndexingService. GET list/get возвращают состояние. Для Demo допускается длительный HTTP request.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F023 criteria. Focused F023/F022 lifecycle tests: 25 passed. Full scripts/verify.sh gate passed Ruff, format (81 files), mypy (38 files), and all configured unit/integration/e2e checks; git diff --check passed. POST persists server-generated metadata/source and runs inline indexing to READY, while failures durably preserve FAILED. GET list/item are workspace-scoped with safe 404 semantics. Filename validation rejects POSIX and Windows traversal/absolute forms, and metadata commit failures roll back and compensate object storage without masking the original error.

The framework-independent QueryService resolves LightRAG only through AuthorizedWorkspaceContext, executes non-streaming retrieval/generation, and returns workspace-scoped READY document sources with document_id/filename. The exact demo-owner POST query route works without JWT, creates unique UUID request IDs, rejects namespace injection/invalid payloads, and maps runtime failures to a safe 502. Focused tests: 6 passed. Full scripts/verify.sh gate passed Ruff, format, mypy, 227 unit tests and integration suite (12 passed, 11 skipped, 1 deselected); git diff --check passed.

features.title: [MVP] Add immutable document revisions
features.behavior: Модель документов расширяется document_revisions, stable document_id, monotonically increasing revision, content_hash, immutable object key и active_revision. Existing Demo rows безопасно мигрируются в revision 1.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 1 passed all F027 criteria. Documents now keep a stable document_id with an active_revision projection over immutable document_revisions rows keyed by (document_id, revision). Repository writes serialize revision allocation with a document-row lock, object URIs are revision-specific and unique, and a PostgreSQL trigger rejects revision updates. Alembic 0004 backfills every existing Demo document into revision 1 while preserving content hash, object URI, and timestamps, and provides a compatible downgrade projection. The mandatory gate passed with 3 tests and 1 Docker-dependent skip; the full verification pipeline passed Ruff, format, mypy, 240 unit tests and 12 integration tests. Live PostgreSQL schema tests skipped only because the sandbox cannot access the Docker daemon; offline Alembic DDL generation and migration inspection passed.

features.title: [MVP] Persist durable indexing jobs
features.behavior: Создаётся jobs state machine PENDING, RUNNING, RETRY, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELLED с attempts, lease/heartbeat, timestamps и safe error metadata. Для одного document запрещены конфликтующие active mutation jobs.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 3 passed all F028 criteria after closing domain/database consistency and regression-coverage gaps. Jobs persist the explicit PENDING/RUNNING/RETRY/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED lifecycle against immutable document revisions, with mirrored attempts, lease/heartbeat, timestamp, bounded error-code, and lease-owner constraints. PostgreSQL enforces one active mutation job per document via a partial unique index while terminal jobs release the slot. The required gate passed with 43 tests and 1 Docker-dependent skip; the full verification pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 281 unit tests and the integration suite (14 passed, 13 skipped, 1 deselected). Offline Alembic DDL and diff checks passed; the live PostgreSQL constraint probes skipped only because Docker is unavailable.

features.title: [MVP] Implement PostgreSQL job claiming and rag-worker
features.behavior: Добавляется отдельный rag-worker process/container. Jobs claim через FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED или эквивалент. Worker вызывает существующий IndexingService, поддерживает heartbeat, graceful shutdown, retry и expired lease recovery.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 3 passed all F029 criteria after resolving READY-before-job-success replay, shutdown-during-recovery, and lease-loss processing races. The separate rag-worker atomically claims jobs with PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, maintains owner-fenced leases and heartbeats, invokes the existing IndexingService for the exact revision, retries safely, recovers expired work, and drains gracefully. A document-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock serializes external mutation across attempts, while exact job/revision/owner/attempt/live-lease fences reject stale document transitions. The focused gate passed with 11 tests and 3 Docker-dependent skips; the full verification pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 288 unit tests and 18 integration tests. Docker Compose validation and diff checks passed; live PostgreSQL tests skipped only because the Docker daemon is unavailable.

features.title: [MVP] Switch upload from inline indexing to durable jobs
features.behavior: Public upload path сохраняет immutable source revision и атомарно создаёт indexing job, затем возвращает PENDING/job_id. Inline path может остаться только dev option. Security semantics остаются demo_owner.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 3 passed all F030 criteria after correcting stale inline-upload documentation. Public upload now stores the immutable source revision and exact durable PENDING indexing job before one PostgreSQL commit, returns revision/status/job_id without storage metadata, and no longer invokes IndexingService inline. Failure rolls back database writes and best-effort deletes the unreferenced source object; DemoOwner DOCUMENT_CREATE authorization remains unchanged. Focused tests passed (3), upload/jobs/worker regression passed (63 passed, 3 skipped), and the full pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 289 unit tests and 20 integration tests (16 skipped, 1 deselected); e2e skipped because Docker/external services were unavailable. git diff --check passed.

features.title: [MVP] Make identical document upsert idempotent
features.behavior: Под per-document transaction/lock одинаковый SHA-256 возвращает action=unchanged и не создаёт revision/job. Конкурентные identical upsert приводят к одной фактической mutation.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 1 passed all F031 criteria. Public PUT upsert computes SHA-256 under a transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock, returns action=unchanged with job_id=null for identical content, and creates no source object, revision, or job on the no-op path. Concurrent identical requests are serialized to exactly one created mutation and one unchanged response; changed content returns 409 without mutation until F032. DemoOwner/workspace isolation and F030 atomic rollback semantics remain intact. The focused gate passed with 2 tests and 1 Docker-dependent skip; the full verification pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 293 unit tests and 20 integration tests (17 skipped, 1 deselected), with e2e skipped because Docker is unavailable. git diff --check passed.

features.title: [MVP] Replace changed document through LightRAG lifecycle
features.behavior: Changed content создаёт новую revision, документ переходит в UPDATING, старая версия удаляется через supported LightRAG operation, новая индексируется, active_revision переключается только после успеха. Application не пишет vectors/graph entities напрямую.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 4 passed all F032 criteria. Changed PUT atomically persists the next immutable revision and durable PENDING job, returns action=updated, moves the document to UPDATING, and keeps the prior revision active until success. The worker claims the real PENDING job, uses supported LightRAG delete-before-insert operations for the exact replacement revision, then atomically activates revision 2, sets READY, and completes the job under owner/attempt/live-lease fences; failures and stale workers cannot activate it. No direct application writes to vector or graph entities were introduced. The focused Docker gate passed 4 tests, migration/job-constraint checks passed 4 tests, the full integration suite passed 39 tests (1 deselected), the full unit suite passed 294 tests, and Ruff, formatting, mypy, and git diff checks passed.

features.title: [MVP] Implement document deletion workflow
features.behavior: DELETE создаёт durable job, переводит document в DELETING, вызывает LightRAG deletion и после подтверждения фиксирует DELETED. Source revisions сохраняются согласно простой retention policy.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F033 criteria. Public DemoOwner DELETE atomically creates a durable DELETE_DOCUMENT job and moves READY documents to DELETING, preserves workspace isolation, and provides explicit idempotent DELETING/DELETED semantics. The production worker claims the real PENDING job, processes it under the document advisory lock, calls only supported LightRAG deletion for the exact active revision, and atomically sets DELETED plus SUCCEEDED under job type, document/revision, owner, attempt, and live-lease fences. Failures and stale workers do not prematurely delete the document; immutable revision rows and source objects are retained under the documented MVP policy. The exact focused gate passed 6 tests, related API/F031/F032 regressions passed 22 tests, the full unit suite passed 301 tests, and Ruff, formatting, mypy, and git diff checks passed. Migration 20260918_0007 and its DELETING/DELETED and DELETE_DOCUMENT constraints were exercised. Broad integration infrastructure errors were unrelated Docker port/startup and external Qdrant timeout failures; the exact F033 Docker gate passed.

features.title: [MVP] Preserve recoverable state on workflow failures
features.behavior: Ошибки parser, embedding, LLM, Qdrant, Neo4j или LightRAG не активируют неподтверждённую revision. Job получает RETRY/FAILED, а source и metadata сохраняются для безопасного повторного исполнения.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F034 criteria. Durable CREATE retains immutable revision/source/job metadata with active_revision=NULL until the exact leased worker attempt successfully reaches READY; UPDATE failures preserve the prior active revision, and DELETE failures remain non-DELETED. Parser, embedding, LLM, Qdrant, Neo4j, and LightRAG-stage failures execute through the real indexing/worker path, transition the exact owner+attempt+live-lease job through bounded RETRY to FAILED, reject stale attempts, and retain recoverable metadata. The exact live Docker/PostgreSQL gate passed 9 tests; migration and F030-F033 regressions passed 24 tests; Ruff, formatting, mypy, git diff checks, 308 unit tests, and 42 integration tests passed. The remaining E2E failure was independently diagnosed as pre-existing Compose sequencing: rag-worker starts before Alembic creates graph_blizz.jobs and exits; no F034 change touches that startup path.

features.title: [MVP] Recover in-flight workflows after restart
features.behavior: После restart rag-api/rag-worker/PostgreSQL expired RUNNING jobs могут быть продолжены без duplicate revision, duplicate logical document или параллельной mutation.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 3 passed all F035 criteria. The exact live gate stopped and restarted PostgreSQL, recovered the same expired RUNNING job, preserved the original job/document/revision identities with one row each, allowed exactly one of two replacement workers to execute, and rejected stale owner/attempt completion. Compose now restarts rag-worker unless explicitly stopped. Test-only Compose teardown uses a short down timeout while production retains its two-minute graceful-stop period. The exact gate passed 2 tests; the full verification pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 308 unit tests, 44 integration tests (1 deselected), and 1 E2E test with no leaked verification projects or port conflicts.

features.title: [MVP] Add Tree-sitter AST parsing foundation
features.behavior: Basic parser registry расширяется Tree-sitter adapters для фиксированного начального набора, например Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/TSX, Java и Go. Syntax errors имеют deterministic fallback; бинарные форматы отклоняются.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F036 criteria. The registry selects Tree-sitter adapters for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, TSX, Java, and Go while preserving MIME precedence; all six grammars execute through Tree-sitter. Malformed syntax produces a deterministic documented single-chunk fallback, and known binary MIME types are rejected before misleading code-extension fallback. The exact gate passed 8 tests, an 18-type binary MIME matrix was rejected, parser/indexing/upload regressions passed 58 tests, and the full pipeline passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 318 unit tests, and 27 integration tests (23 skipped, 1 deselected); the E2E test was skipped because Docker was unavailable.

features.title: [MVP] Produce semantic code chunks
features.behavior: Source code делится по module/class/function/method boundaries; слишком крупные symbols дополнительно режутся по token limit. Каждый chunk сохраняет path, language, symbol, symbol_type, parent_symbol и start/end line.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F037 criteria. Semantic AST chunking is deterministic for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript/TSX, Java, and Go; oversized regions respect the explicit token limit; required path/language/symbol hierarchy and inclusive line metadata are preserved as strings; ordered chunks reconstruct Unicode source losslessly; and the F036 syntax-error fallback remains compatible. Exact gate: 10 passed; focused integration: 6 passed; full verification: Ruff, formatting, mypy, 328 unit tests, and 27 integration tests passed. Infrastructure-only Docker/GPU scenarios were skipped by the standard gates.

features.title: [MVP] Preserve rich source provenance through retrieval
features.behavior: Query response для source code возвращает document_id, revision, path, language, symbol и line ranges, когда они доступны. Metadata проходит parser -> indexing -> retrieval без потери document identity.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F038 criteria. Source-code parser metadata is encoded into deterministic LightRAG chunk documents and returned as document_id, revision, path, language, symbol, start_line, and end_line when available. Query validates citations against workspace-scoped READY documents at the active revision while preserving legacy and non-code behavior. Replacement indexing uses the target job revision and is covered with actual Tree-sitter chunks. Exact gate: 2 passed; focused regressions: 23 passed, 4 infrastructure-dependent skipped; full verification: Ruff, formatting, mypy, 330 unit tests, and 28 integration tests passed; infrastructure-only E2E was skipped.

features.title: [MVP] Prove multi-workspace data isolation
features.behavior: E2E создаёт workspace A и B под одним Demo Owner, загружает разные знания и доказывает, что query A не возвращает B и наоборот. Проверяется actual isolation PostgreSQL/LightRAG/Qdrant/Neo4j независимо от user ACL.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 1 passed all F039 criteria with no issues. The E2E creates two workspaces under one Demo Owner through public APIs, indexes distinct facts, proves bidirectional answer/source isolation, and directly validates physical partitioning in PostgreSQL, LightRAG, Qdrant, and Neo4j. Exact gate was infrastructure-skipped because Docker daemon is unavailable; Ruff, format, mypy, git diff check, and the full available pipeline passed with 330 unit and 28 integration tests; 2 Docker-dependent E2E tests skipped.

features.title: [MVP] Add parser and index schema versioning
features.behavior: Workspace хранит index_schema_version и embedding profile identity; revisions фиксируют parser/chunk/index versions. Несовместимое изменение помечает данные requiring reindex вместо смешивания несовместимых индексов.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 4 passed all F040 criteria with no blocker or major issues. Workspaces persist index schema and canonical embedding-profile identity; revisions persist actual parser/chunk/index versions; contract changes serialize on the workspace row, atomically mark active non-deleted revisions for reindex, and select schema/profile-isolated LightRAG runtimes. Migration 0009 safely backfills Demo rows and renders correct offline upgrade/downgrade SQL. Exact gate passed with 4 tests and 3 Docker-only skips; focused checks passed with 19 tests and 5 Docker-only skips; full verification passed Ruff, format, mypy, 331 unit tests and 30 integration tests; 2 Docker-dependent E2E tests skipped.

features.title: [MVP] Implement durable workspace reindex
features.behavior: Maintenance operation создаёт durable jobs и перестраивает derived indexes из PostgreSQL metadata и MinIO revisions. Reindex переживает restart и не требует повторной загрузки originals.
features.evidence: Independent verification iteration 2 passed all F041 criteria with no issues. The maintenance operation reconciles the active index contract and enqueues durable reindex jobs in one transaction; workers recover PostgreSQL revision metadata and persisted MinIO originals, survive retry/restart through durable leases, and atomically mark jobs successful, update provenance, and clear requires_reindex only after indexing. Failures preserve recoverable state. Required gate: 5 passed, 1 Docker-only skip; full verification passed Ruff, formatting, mypy, 336 unit tests and 30 integration tests; git diff, compileall, and single-head Alembic history checks passed.

features.title: [MVP] Verify full single-owner lifecycle and persistence
features.behavior: Full-stack E2E выполняет create, READY, unchanged upsert, changed revision, query v2, delete, restart stack и повторную проверку persisted source-of-truth state. Security остаётся demo_owner и не участвует в критерии успешности.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Introduce persisted principals
features.behavior: Добавляются principals с USER/SERVICE_ACCOUNT, external subject, status и timestamps. DemoOwner runtime identity остаётся отдельным mode и не требует auto-creation production principals.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Define centralized RBAC permission policy
features.behavior: Определяется единая versioned policy roles reader/writer/admin/owner -> workspace/query/document/member/index permissions. Endpoint-код не содержит дублированных role checks.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Persist workspace membership and ACL
features.behavior: Создаётся workspace_members с unique workspace/principal assignment и validated role. Repository вычисляет effective permissions только для active principals/workspaces через policy F044.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Authenticate through OIDC JWT
features.behavior: Реализуется OIDCIdentityResolver: Bearer JWT signature/issuer/audience/expiration/subject validation, bounded JWKS cache и exact active-principal resolution. Нет неявного fallback из oidc в demo_owner.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Implement production RBAC workspace access policy
features.behavior: RBACWorkspaceAccessPolicy заменяет DemoOwnerAccessPolicy в oidc mode и создаёт тот же AuthorizedWorkspaceContext после membership/permission checks. Document/query/indexing domain services не изменяются.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Support service-account principals
features.behavior: SERVICE_ACCOUNT проходит тот же OIDC/client-credentials identity resolution и ACL path, что USER. Собственные бессрочные application API keys не вводятся как основной механизм.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Expose workspace member management API
features.behavior: Добавляются GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /v1/workspaces/{id}/members. Операции gated members.read/members.manage и недоступны через DemoOwner-only public contract без явного feature enablement.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Prove authorization isolation end-to-end
features.behavior: E2E проверяет reader/writer/admin/owner restrictions, disabled principal denial и отсутствие cross-workspace доступа без membership. Graph RAG functionality должна совпадать с Demo/MVP при наличии разрешения.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Persist immutable audit events
features.behavior: Создаётся append-only audit_events с principal, workspace, action, resource, result, request_id, timestamp и safe metadata. Repository не предоставляет обычный update/delete для existing events.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Complete audit coverage for sensitive actions
features.behavior: Audit events создаются для auth failures, member changes, workspace changes, document create/update/delete, reindex и query metadata. Raw query text и полный document content не сохраняются по умолчанию.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Harden internal network boundaries
features.behavior: Во внешнюю сеть публикуется только rag-api и при необходимости IdP. PostgreSQL, MinIO, Qdrant, Neo4j, rag-worker и vLLM остаются internal-only. Automated test проверяет published ports.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Harden secrets and configurable endpoint policy
features.behavior: Secrets не попадают в git/config responses/audit/logs. Настраиваемые OpenAI-compatible endpoints проходят URL validation/egress policy, исключающую произвольный доступ к внутренним адресам.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Add OpenTelemetry metrics and tracing
features.behavior: HTTP, jobs, retrieval, embeddings и LLM calls instrumentируются OpenTelemetry. request_id/trace_id связывают API request с worker и downstream calls. Integration test использует local collector.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Introduce MCP-ready domain facade
features.behavior: Выделяются application methods list_workspaces, query_workspace, list_documents, upsert_document, delete_document и get_job_status. REST использует тот же facade; facade принимает AuthorizedWorkspaceContext и не раскрывает storage clients.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Verify disaster-recovery rebuild from source of truth
features.behavior: E2E очищает derived Qdrant/Neo4j data и выполняет reindex из PostgreSQL metadata и MinIO revisions. После rebuild Graph RAG снова отвечает по исходным документам.

features.title: [POST-MVP] Add Kubernetes-readiness runtime contracts
features.behavior: Добавляются /health/ready semantics, SIGTERM/graceful shutdown, configurable replicas/worker concurrency и запрет critical local-filesystem state. Helm chart не входит в задачу.

features.title: [DEMO] Expose web interfaces and FastAPI documentation
features.behavior: Docker Compose публикует rag-api с FastAPI Swagger/ReDoc и web console MinIO на настраиваемых host-портах. PostgreSQL остаётся internal-only, а README описывает адреса подключения.
features.verification: docker compose config && pytest -q tests/unit/test_app_bootstrap.py tests/unit/test_compose_web_access.py
features.evidence: Independent live Compose verification: Swagger /docs and /redoc returned HTTP 200; MinIO API health and Console returned HTTP 200 with effective host bindings; PostgreSQL remained unpublished/internal-only. Focused tests: 10 passed; ./scripts/verify.sh: lint, format, mypy, 110 unit tests and 3 integration tests passed (8 skipped).

features.title: [POST-MVP] Establish final regression gate and synchronize documentation
features.behavior: Финальный scripts/verify.sh объединяет lint/typecheck, unit, integration, MVP E2E и security suites; GPU tests остаются отдельным profile. architecture.md, README и operational docs описывают DemoOwner, OIDC/RBAC migration, backup/recovery, logging, observability и deployment boundaries.
